result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner's white text on a light mint-green background has very poor contrast, making the headline, promo code, and 'Order now' context hard to read.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' banner renders white text on a very light mint-green background. The headline and especially the subtitle 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' have extremely low contrast and are barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text (e.g., dark green or near-black) on the light green banner background to ensure sufficient contrast, while keeping the 'Order now' button as a high-contrast element.
